notes.title: Control Update live! yay :-)
notes.content:
Ok soooo, you now have control over thrust and firing! A new toggle button has been added to the main menu, if its lit your in auto fire thrust mode, if not you can manual thrust and fire with your 360 controller or keyboard control. (shift/z/space to fire and up to thrust) please share any thoughts/bugs ect

cheers
Kingsguard

notes.title: Control update on the way
notes.content:
It kills getting your first bad review BUT i love constructive crit! Why not have thrust and shot control? will be making a new Build soonish, subject to time ect with controlable thrust and firing for those who want it.

PS this game was develped for mobile and simple 2 thumb control, happy to add options for more control if people want it.
